text:
alex: Observing weird billing preview noise: small steady token counts (~100-300 tokens/min) labeled as unattributed for customers using fallback routing. Anyone digging?
mira: saw a blip in us-west earlier, looked like heartbeat/idle pings were leaking into metering.
chao: can you paste an example event?
alex: here's sanitized event we pulled from the edge: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-02T03:12:10Z","session":"s-0x9","type":"ping","route_id":null,"tokens":0,"headers":{}}
```
noah: route_id null on pings -> ingest marks event as "unattributed". later requests in same session get attributed, but those zero-token pings still show up in preview counts and skew meters.
rebecca: UX question: should heartbeats count at all for invoice preview? they have 0 tokens but still trigger session joins in aggregation which confuses sampling.
achao: technical fix options: 1) populate route on ping at the edge/proxy, 2) change ingest to join pings to last-seen route by session id, 3) filter pings out from billing preview and sampling.
mira: 1 is best for correctness but touches router; 2 centralizes logic but is harder to reason about for replay/backfills; 3 is quick but feels like hiding problem.
alex: risk matrix: edge change -> needs canary (affects Hosted + Dedicated routing), ingest change -> complex joins and more consumer load, filter -> console mismatch vs ledger.
noah: for Dedicated/Private customers we can't deploy router change easily. we need an opt-in flag or operator toggle if we go edge-first.
rebecca: proposed minimal plan: (a) ingest change to accept optional header "X-Route-Id" when present and use it; (b) edge adds header on ping in hosted canary only; (c) console preview adds "ping attribution" card to show impact; (d) backfill to reassign unaccounted pings for last 72h flagged as adjustment.
achao: ingest: also add metric metering.ping_join_latency and metering.unattributed_ping_rate. add alert if unattributed_ping_rate > 0.3% for 15m during canary.
mira: console mock: small line chart "unattributed pings" plus toggle to include/exclude for preview. show adjustment count if backfill ran.
alex: about proto: we need a tiny schema change to accept route_origin + route_id in the sideband headers or proto extras. will open protos PR.
noah: will ops need migration docs? yes. also for private offers, add operator flag `inject_ping_route_headers` default false.
rebecca: backfill: run a join on session id where later events in the session contain route_id and earlier pings don't; create preview adjustments with audit metadata `backfill:ping-reattribute-2026-03-02`.
achao: caveat: session ids can be reused in edge for long time windows; limit backfill to sessions with stable route (same route_id for all later events) to avoid misassign.
mira: agree. add a safety threshold: only reassign if 95% of subsequent events have same route_id.
alex: timeline: protos PR + ingest header support this week, edge canary next Tue (1% hosted), monitor for 12h, then expand. backfill after canary clears.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy edge-router-canary PR #4992 at 2026-03-09T02:00Z :rocket:
noah: i'll own the ingest change and alert dashboards. rebecca can you own console mockups?
rebecca: yes, will drop wires in product-design and link here.
achao: i'll craft the backfill tool spec and run a dry-run on stash data.
mira: let's also add a tiny note in release-notes: "Fix: heartbeat/ping attribution to reduce preview noise (opt-in for self-hosted)."
alex: perfect. we'll reconvene after the canary window. thanks team :thumbsup:
